description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called 'AnalyticsScreen' along with several supporting widgets and data classes to build an analytics dashboard. It includes components for KPI metrics, filters, data visualizations placeholders, score summaries, and task lists. It is entirely self-contained with mock data, intended for the front-end presentation layer in a Flutter application.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the analytics dashboard screen, composed of various subcomponents.

classes.name: _AnalyticsScreenState
classes.description: State class for 'AnalyticsScreen' handling the widget build method.

classes.name: _KpiRow
classes.description: Widget displaying a row of KPI summaries with icons and labels.

classes.name: _KpiData
classes.description: Data class for individual KPI metric data.

classes.name: _KpiChips
classes.description: Widget rendering a horizontally scrollable list of filter chips.

classes.name: _ChipData
classes.description: Data class for individual chip info.

classes.name: _ChartPlaceholder
classes.description: Widget showing a placeholder for a chart, with title, subtitle, and a graphical representation.

classes.name: _ScoreSummary
classes.description: Widget rendering a score summary card, including a sparkline visualization.

classes.name: _TaskList
classes.description: Widget presenting a list of tasks or activities with icons and subtitles.

classes.name: _TaskItem
classes.description: Data class for individual task entries.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for 'AnalyticsScreen' state, constructs the entire scrollable dashboard layout.

methods.name: _KpiRow.build
methods.description: Builds a row with KPI metric cards.

methods.name: _KpiChips.build
methods.description: Constructs a horizontally scrolling list of filter chips.

methods.name: _ChartPlaceholder.build
methods.description: Builds the placeholder card for data visualization.

methods.name: _ScoreSummary.build
methods.description: Builds the score summary section with sparkline.

methods.name: _SparklinePainter.paint
methods.description: Draws the sparkline graph lines and dot.

methods.name: _TaskList.build
methods.description: Builds a list of task items with icons.

methods.name: _segChip
methods.description: Creates a styled label chip for score breakdowns.
